_comment: Ad inventory. Every ad is ALWAYS labelled 'Sponsored' in the UI. Paid campaigns (type != house) take priority over house ads in the same slot. Expired campaigns are hidden automatically. See ADVERTISE.md.

network._comment: Optional ad network (e.g. Carbon Ads, EthicalAds). Leave enabled=false until you have an account. When on, it fills slots that have no direct campaign.

campaigns.title: Reach every Omarchy user
campaigns.body: Put your app or product in front of Linux power users. Banner and featured slots available.

campaigns.title: Built something for Omarchy?
campaigns.body: Get it listed in the store for free.

campaigns._comment: Template for a paid 'sponsored app' placement. type=app promotes a store listing; set enabled=true once paid.
